What makes us different?

Safe Carry 305 was built for people who have never touched a firearm, taught by certified instructors who keep every class small and safety-first.

  1. 01

    Small on purpose

    Max 4 students per class, so your instructor sees every grip, every stance, every rep. Nobody gets lost in the crowd.

  2. 02

    Certified instructors

    You learn from NRA certified instructors whose whole job is teaching beginners well.

  3. 03

    Safety first, always

    Safety is not a speech at the start. It is the curriculum, from the first minute to the last round.

  4. 04

    Built for true beginners

    No experience needed and no ego on the line. Questions are the point of the class, not an interruption.

  5. 05

    Private 1-on-1 option

    Prefer to learn one on one? Private sessions move at your pace, on your schedule.

  6. 06

    Covers Florida CWL requirements

    The class covers the training Florida requires for your concealed weapons license application.

On the range

Hands-on coaching in a small group at both indoor and outdoor ranges.

How registration works

  • Pick your format: group class (3 hours, max 4 students) or private 1-on-1 (2 hours). Both are $150. For a private 1-on-1, leave your phone number and an instructor will call you to schedule the class.
  • Reserve your seat below. Payment is due in full to confirm it, and you can cancel 48 hours or more before class start for a full refund.
  • Show up ready to learn. Range fee, firearm, ammo, and eye and ear protection are all provided.
